# Aquatic Bath

> Aquatic Bath is a leading manufacturer of luxury hydrotherapy bathtubs, showers, and accessible bathing solutions featuring proprietary AcrylX™ technology and innovative wellness features.

Aquatic Bath specializes in premium bathroom fixtures with a focus on hydrotherapy, accessibility, and design flexibility. Their product portfolio spans luxury soaking tubs, whirlpool massage systems, air baths, and ADA-compliant accessible solutions across multiple collections including Everyday Series, Serenity, and DriftBath™ therapy systems.

## Key Topics

- AcrylX™ material
- Hydrotherapy technology
- ADA compliance
- Whirlpool massage jets
- Air massage therapy
- DriftBath™ therapy
- Accessible design
- Soaking tubs
- Shower bases
- Roll-in showers
- Combo massage systems
- Everyday Series
- Serenity collection
- Universal design
- Shiatsu technology

## Core Product Categories

- [Luxury Soaking Bathtubs](https://aquaticbath.com/bathtubs): Product catalog of luxury bathtubs in various styles and installation types.
- [Tub Shower Combo Collections](https://aquaticbath.com/tub-showers): Tub shower combo products featuring Icon family and space-saving designs.
- [Showers](https://aquaticbath.com/showers): Shower product line including Icon Series in various shapes and ADA-compliant options.
- [Shower Bases](https://aquaticbath.com/shower-bases): Shower bases including low-threshold and roll-in options with ADA compliance.
- [Shower Doors](https://aquaticbath.com/shower-doors): Shower door products including Coastal, Darsey, and Paragon sliding options.
- [Tub and Shower Suites](https://aquaticbath.com/tub-and-shower-suites): Customizable tub and shower suite combinations with design flexibility.

## Hydrotherapy & Wellness Systems

- [Hydrotherapy Bath and Spa Products](https://aquaticbath.com/hydrotherapy): Hydrotherapy products including HotSoak, DriftBath, whirlpool, and air baths.
- [Whirlpool Massage Therapy](https://aquaticbath.com/whirlpool-massage): Whirlpool massage therapy baths with up to 24 jets across multiple collections.
- [Air Massage Therapy](https://aquaticbath.com/air-massage): Air bath hydrotherapy featuring bubble massage and LED chromatherapy options.
- [Combo Massage Therapy](https://aquaticbath.com/combo-massage): Combo massage baths combining whirlpool jets and air bubbles with Shiatsu technology.
- [DriftBath Therapy](https://aquaticbath.com/driftbath-therapy): DriftBath exclusive therapy with up to 70 ports on Serenity models.
- [Soaking Tubs](https://aquaticbath.com/soaking-tubs): Deep soaking tubs including HotSoak and Serenity for immersive relaxation.

## Accessible & Universal Design

- [Accessible Series: ADA-Compliant Solutions](https://aquaticbath.com/accessible): Accessible Series featuring ADA-compliant roll-in showers and barrier-free designs.

## Product Collections

- [Everyday Series](https://aquaticbath.com/everyday): Everyday Series product line featuring AcrylX material and practical designs.
